resources.string: Type a whole message with one tap
Make a quiKey once. Then tap it on your keyboard and the message is typed for you.
Add a time, a date, a number or a list. The keyboard asks you with big buttons.
The coloured words are the parts that change.
Put quiKies in folders. Press and hold a tile, then drag it to move it. To delete many at once, tap the tick at the top.
A few ready-made quiKies to try, like Kids and Running late. You can edit or delete them.
You can add them later in Settings.
Your words stay on your phone
quiKey has no internet. Nothing you type leaves your phone.
Your quiKies are only on this phone.
One quick step in your phone\'s settings.
To use it, tap the keyboard icon at the bottom of your screen when you are typing, then choose quiKey.
A quick look at how it works.
Add the starter folders and quiKies again. Yours stay as they are.
You already have all the examples.
A few ready-made ones to try: Kids, Running late and more. You can edit or delete them.
Delete every quiKey and folder on this phone.
Every quiKey and folder is deleted. This cannot be undone. Back up first if you want a copy.
As simple or as complex as you like
A quiKey can be plain words, or have as many changing parts as you need.
